answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on the following language generation tasks: (1) Assistant on HH-RLHF  dataset, (2) Summary on Summarizefrom-Feedback  dataset, and (3) Summary+ on SummEval  dataset.
answer_1.outputs: personalized responses for user requests, personalized summaries for user-provided articles

answer_3.quote: In Summary+, we consider "coherence," "consistency," "fluency," and "relevance." We employ G-Eval , a unified language evaluation framework, to compute rewards for these four attributes, without relying on pre-existing models. We use GPT-4 to run G-Eval.
